OpenBao.PORT: Only the gateway port is public; backend and cluster listeners stay loopback-only.
OpenBao.BAO_API_ADDR: Stable HTTPS origin of the gateway; local HTTP is accepted only for loopback tests.
OpenBao.OPERATOR_GATE_KEY: Random gateway operator key, at least 32 ASCII characters. NOT an OpenBao token or unseal share.
OpenBao.PUBLIC_DATA_PLANE: false keeps every API operator-gated. true allows only secret/transit paths and AppRole login; native OpenBao authorization still applies.
